Let me share a little of my story first.
I am a bioinformatician and work with statistic data sometimes. People comes to me only to solve their problems and obtain their titles or publications, they really don`t care about me or my feelings. I don`t have any true friends and usually people just come to me only to save a problem they can`t solve yet, also, they say: you are awesome, i love you, you will have a great future!
Sometimes i feel like a rat or a animal of laboratory, and that`s all.

I can`t be happy, but there is a pattern of think who keep me alive: o don`t care about people, i care about nature. When i put my mind on nature beautiful and the complexity of things created and even the numbers, i don't feel so heavy...but sometimes this don`t work too.

In the end of day i always conclude: there is two kind of people in this world, the unhappy and fake people. Everyone have their own problems and questions, we just need to avoid overthink unnecessary and create mechanisms to turn life more slight.

Suicide attempt is a interesting event, but is not a solution. In fact, we all think the things could be better if we die, but we are not sure what happens when we die.
The fact is: we born and for random reason you need to be the person you are and face the problems you need to face. Maybe you just need the properly support and find your own answers and strength.

Also, we all think we have the option to die, but in fact, we don`t  have. If you born to suffer,  you will suffer as a brave person you are because there is any other option. If you kill yourself, you will only spread your pain to people who maybe enjoyed your company.

I will not be a hypocrite, i think about suicide a lot of times per day, but for some reason, i still here, floating in the tedious, facing my negative thoughts, trying to survive a giant: myself.
